contract.order_policy: every feasible permutation of every distinct evidence set; semantic correctness reported apart from order stability, and an engine comparison only where the result survives ordering
contract.single_change: the decision is stated on its own line and scored alone; SUPPORT and CONTRAST are recorded and never scored
contract.unparsed_policy: recorded and excluded from both verdicts, never scored as a failure
contract.why: Gen85 charged a correct recommendation for citing the counterexample it argued against; a citation channel cannot separate a choice from its evidence, and this contract does
